svg.title: Source-traced cartoon pair with held portrait
svg.desc: Optional source-traced extraction of the supplied cartoon because its numeric filename provided no written brief. The two figures and handheld portrait remain one grouped ink drawing. Vectorized from a cropped, thresholded view of G3-001; full-resolution original is linked beside the SVG. This is a visual source-trace, not an independently verified historical reconstruction. Source G3-001.
svg.metadata: Source G3-001. contemporary study; editable named groups; no embedded raster.
